title: 1.11 Friends and People
unit_outcome: Understand and produce simple sentences about people, family members, and actions.
goal: Name a friend, a husband and wife, a son and daughter, and people in general, and say what they and their pets are doing.
grammar_function: A friend / Friends; The + family relation; He/She is the + relation; They are friends; The + person + and the + pet + are + action; A person and a pet / People and pets.
prerequisite: Lessons 1.1-1.10: a, the, he, she, they, is, are, and, the Unit 1 actions, and the Pets words dog, cat, bird, rabbit, pet and pets.
speaking_outcome: Name the husband, the wife, the son and the daughter, say They are friends, and say what a person and a pet are doing together.
